name: public-cmdlet-admission
decisionRule: Only operations explicitly present in the current public CmdletModel may be public cmdlets.

gates.evidence: corrected normalized operation with method, path, provenance, parameters, responses, and representations
zero or fully evidenced API correction ambiguity
one canonical public mapping and deterministic parameter-set identities
parameter sets have distinct signatures or an explicit PowerShell-only discriminator
shared runtime supports method, request/response representations, envelope/error policy, pagination, and cancellation contract
request/response models retain schema provenance, type, nullability, presence, and union/map semantics
candidate public CmdletModel is visible to P2.4 projection compatibility
verb/noun and help surface are explicit policy, not heuristic-only inference
ShouldProcess, confirmation, body/presence, retry/idempotency, and destructive semantics are not unresolved
operation is in the bounded public policy and its complete artifact/source/mock gates pass
canonical admitted cmdlets exactly equal generated public source, module manifest/script, generated help, runtime module exports, coverage, and P2.4 surface

nonAdmissionRules: Projection construction, normalization success, runtime readiness, or generated C# alone never imply public admission.
Generic scope or HTTP-method parameter-set disambiguation resolves a projection identity only; it does not grant public admission.
Low-confidence semantic inference remains NeedsManualReview until evidence-backed semantic policy exists.

Unresolved HTTP 2xx with success=false, legacy authentication, automatic idempotency, complete mutation retry safety, real-account behavior, and release evidence remain outside this policy unless separately proven.
